releaseNote:
新增内置草稿画板、竞赛绘图模板与图片导出。内置 Fira Code，引导支持字体和连字选择、即时预览，并记住代码存放目录（支持便携目录移动）。Windows 提供用户安装版与便携版。

Added an offline sketchpad with competition templates and image export. Bundled Fira Code, added font and ligature choices with live previews to setup, and remembered code folders across restarts and portable moves. Windows provides per-user and portable packages.
